name: An affidavit for a wire
prompt: The case needs a wiretap, and a judge signs one only on an affidavit that shows every other way was tried first.

choices.text: Write it out in full, every lead and every dead end

outcome.told: It takes the week. The judge signs it without a question.

choices.text: Take it to the judge as it stands

outcome.told: The judge signs. By Friday the calls are coming in, and two of them name a stash house.

failure.told: The judge sends it back with questions you can't answer yet. The supervisor reads the note too.
